provenance: Codex subagent review of immutable prepared inputs; findings checked against source, separate from deterministic validation.
rationale: Configuration consists of State and List Statement. Configuration.initial uses State.empty and program.body; the fixed class table is an external Step parameter. The tuple and initial configuration agree component by component. Notation and premises are supplied by the examined units given.classes, given.collections, given.empty_state, given.identities, given.programs, given.slots, given.state, given.syntax.
limitations: This compares the authored statement/definition/example with the selected formalization. It does not independently recheck Lean proof tactics or attest to a compiler run.
